description: Ten global band powers averaged on the per-band electrode lists hardcoded in Angela's cognitive-mllm eeg_analysis.py, intersected with this 32-channel cap. Those lists are not cited to a paper. Sites we do not record were dropped, not replaced. Derived measures stay on current_v1. Not confirmatory. Cleaning stays full-montage. Hz edges stay 0.5–4 / 4–8 / 8–13 / 13–30 / 30–40.

provenance.source: scripts/cognitive-mllm/eeg_preprocessing/eeg_analysis.py BAND_CHANNELS (also eeg_analysis_testing_Sebastian.py). Not a published montage.
provenance.angela_paper_cites: Zheng 2015 and Cochran 1967 for band names; Newson 2019 for Hz edges; Smith 2017 for F3–F4 FAA. No per-band electrode citation.

dropped_not_on_this_cap.FCz: theta; acquisition_contract.md: FCz is not a recorded data channel

provenance.what_this_file_does: Uses the intersection with the recorded 32 sites. Does not invent nearest-neighbour replacements. Alpha on this list is the same six sites as confirmatory posterior alpha.
provenance.not_used: George nine-site, Wang zones, AES-region map. Do not mix.

cleaning.note: Do not subset channels before notch, average reference, interpolation, or ICA.
